name: OMathRecognizedFunctions
description: Represents a collection of recognized functions. Use the OMathRecognizedFunction object to access individual members of the collection.
remarks: The OMathRecognizedFunctions collection is a collection of the names that are contained in the Recognized Functions dialog box.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathRecognizedFunctions object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the OMathRecognizedFunctions collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an OMathRecognizedFunction object that represents the specified item in the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies a String or Integer that represents the name or ordinal position of the object in the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Creates a new recognized function and returns an OMathRecognizedFunction object.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the recognized function.
